# SelfUpdateManager

> **File:** `services/core/SelfUpdateManager.qml` · **Docs:** see [docs/dev](../../README.md)

Updates axiom itself (not packages: that's UpdatesManager). It follows the clone's remote on SelfUpdate.channel: "tags" (releases, `v*` tags) or "main" (every commit on the main branch). scripts/self_update.sh does the git work: `check` fetches and compares, `apply` fast-forwards to the newest. A clone with changed tracked files, local commits or another branch is `blocked` and never touched. SelfUpdate.mode: "auto" installs a new release and notifies; "notify" notifies, and the notification opens Settings → Updates; "off" never checks. Checks run once per qs launch (not per hot reload), daily, and when the channel changes. Each release (or main's commit) is notified once. A packaged axiom (the AUR's axiom-shell, Paths.packaged) is updated by its package manager: this never checks, and its settings are hidden. axiom ipc selfUpdate check axiom ipc selfUpdate update axiom ipc selfUpdate open
